messages:
elaine: opened a short how-to PR for airgapped image signing + installer image verification for private installs. includes example of signing the offline bundle, verifying on target, and an optional HSM-backed signing step. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1024 :sparkles:
ravi: great. can you include a tiny ruby SDK snippet that shows verifying a signed artifact before extraction? a bunch of our ops folks use ruby.
elainE: small typo in my headliner — should be "elaine" not elainE ;). adding ruby snippet, systemd snippet, and exact gpg commands.
omar: for the HSM step, include a note that customers using PKCS#11 should prefer signing via HSM to avoid key exfil. maybe a short pkcs11tool example.
ke: also add a troubleshooting bullet: "installer complains: signature mismatch" — list causes: modified bundle, wrong public key, expired signing cert, clock skew. include commands to dump the bundle manifest and re-run verification.
elaine: plan: - gpg --detach-sign example for tar.gz - pkcs11sign example pointing to pkcs11:manufacturer - ruby verify snippet using OpenSSL - systemd unit to run verify-and-extract as a one-shot service - small manifest inspection commands - short note about storing pubkey in /etc/redwood/trusted-keys
ravi: ruby snippet idea:
```ruby
# redwood-ruby verify example
require 'openssl'
require 'base64'

sig = File.read('/mnt/repo/bundle.tar.gz.sig')
pub = OpenSSL::PKey::RSA.new(File.read('/etc/redwood/trusted-keys/bundle.pub'))
data = File.read('/mnt/repo/bundle.tar.gz')
ok = pub.verify(OpenSSL::Digest::SHA256.new, Base64.decode64(sig), data)
puts ok ? 'signature OK' : 'signature FAILED'
```
omar: pkcs11 note: include example where signing is delegated to HSM via pkcs11-tool: `pkcs11-tool --module /usr/lib/softhsm/libsofthsm2.so --sign --id 01 --mechanism RSA-PKCS -i bundle.tar.gz -o bundle.sig` and mention that pin should not be in cleartext in scripts.
ke: systemd unit to verify and extract:
```ini
[Unit]
Description=Verify and extract offline bundle
After=local-fs.target

[Service]
Type=oneshot
ExecStart=/usr/local/bin/redwood-verify-and-extract /mnt/repo/bundle.tar.gz /etc/redwood/trusted-keys/bundle.pub
RemainAfterExit=no

[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target
```
elaine: added manifest inspection tips: `tar -tvf bundle.tar.gz | head` and `sha256sum bundle.tar.gz` for checksum compare. also recommend storing checksum in a signed manifest file.
ravi: wording nit: prefer "trusted keys directory" path to be consistent: use `/var/lib/redwood/trusted-keys` in the doc.
elaine: updated paths accordingly. also added a short paragraph about automating key provisioning to hosts via our private control plane for Dedicated customers, with a link to the onboarding endpoint (placeholder).
docs-bot: lint: docs PR 1024 queued; running spellcheck + security-scan for secrets. :gear:
omar: small security suggestion: emphasize ephemeral keys on build machines and rotate signing key per-release. add one sentence about HSM-backed key attestations (optional).
ke: reviewer checklist suggestion: 1) run verify script against a signed sample bundle 2) try a tampered bundle and confirm installer refuses to run 3) confirm systemd unit exits non-zero on verification failure 4) check docs for clear "not a replacement for HSM in prod" warnings
elaine: tagging reviewers @ravi @omar @ke. I'll run CI fixes once lint finishes and post back with results. thanks! :pray:
